title: Classic American Potato Casserole
description: A comforting, rich casserole made with mashed russet potatoes and topped with a crispy, golden-brown crust.
instructions: Boil the russet potatoes until tender.
Mash the cooked potatoes with butter, milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix sour cream and shredded cheddar cheese.
Combine the mashed potatoes and sour cream mixture.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the milk and stir until smooth.
Pour the milk mixture over the potato mixture in the baking dish.
Top with additional shredded cheddar cheese if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
